Build passes (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both hidden behind the warning wall:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — the bundler renamed `options.retries` → `options.retryCount`; this call site still read `.retries`, so it threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. Now reads `retryCount ?? retries` with an explicit type check.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`; the strict boolean check threw on that. Absent flag now maps to the old default (disabled).

The remaining 8 warnings are genuine noise but worth queuing separately — notably `W3307 circular-import: src/core/graph.js <-> src/state/tracker.js` (undefined resolution order, a latent bug) and `W1042 crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`, which is deprecated and cryptographically unsafe. Those files aren't in this tree, so I left them alone.
